The types are the header's own too -- PKPassLibraryCapability and PKPassLibraryAuthorizationStatus (PKPassLibrary.h:30, :34) -- and they are declared in CharonPassKit.h because the 16.4 SDK this package builds against has neither them nor the two methods
entries.source: the SDK 26.2 (iPhoneOS26.2.sdk under the iphoneos-sdk 26.2 package), PassKit.framework headers: every method row's selector is grep'd in them by tools/check-passkit-selectors.py, which is the check the review asked for and is what found the invented spellings. And apple.objc.inventory against the armv7 dyld shared cache of 6.1.3: PKPass, PKPassLibrary and PKAddPassesViewController are there (90, 34 and 26 instance methods), and PKPaymentAuthorizationController and PKPaymentAuthorizationViewController are absent entirely
